name: strudel-player
title: StrudelPlayer
description: An audio player for a Strudel live-coded pattern, inline code or a .strudel file: play/stop, a scrolling piano roll, the code, and an equipment rack. Strudel runs in the page, loaded on the first play; one pattern plays at a time. A re-export of the player at @brett_lamy/ui/docstream/strudel and the functions that drive its runtime.
